method: All current runtime answer scripts screened against all 650 prior runtime answer scripts, plus exact task/answer checks. Editorial comparison of topic/premise candidates and full close-pair scripts produced documented causal replacements on the current merged corpus; explicit decision is in the hash-bound semantic-review file. Text scores do not establish content approval.
editorialDecision: AI content PASS with specific causal replacements and whole-prefecture notes; not native, translation or real-policy approval
retainedTopicDistinctions: Term savings/current balance versus earlier single payroll entry/balance: asset location and avoiding double total, not extracting pay amount.
Reimbursement promise versus bank receipt: payer execution and unmatched deposits, not balance reporting.
Direct adult civic name-reading correction versus child school enrolment reading: same spelling and existing inquiry retained, not new guardian/student record.
Deposit coin counting/weight uncertainty versus foreign-coin separation: one controls uncounted amount and fees, the other classifies eligible currency.
Unused wrong-name specimen container versus misissued bill: prevents unidentifiable sample submission before collection, not correcting a monetary document.
Cooked platter share versus meal departure payment split: orders food/empty plates, not allocating the bill.

retainedPairAssessments.decision: Current two separately complete parcels ask whether tying them makes one shipping unit and compare two-item acceptance versus an outer box. Prior one box has sliding books and needs internal support. Grouping/billing unit and external retention differ from shifting contents; common book/clothing nouns do not establish same causal sequence.

Current civic application remains an unsent draft, requiring submission/state inquiry. Prior online symptom questionnaire has been sent but does not constitute a dated appointment. Saved-but-unsent and sent-but-separate-action are different states and requested staff actions.

Current form was detached before handwriting, so lower carbon sheets lack reproduced address. Rewrite while assembled and inspect lower copy; prior preserves a copy of an existing original before mailing it. Different production failure and remedial steps.

Current paid item may remain at the bagging table, and customer requests locating/receipt-identifying it before collection. Prior unpaid item is deliberately cancelled and its checkout total recomputed. Current explicitly does not ask to delete the receipt item.

Current whole request changes civic callback channel to email and verifies an address, with phone fallback subject to service confirmation. Prior whole request identifies a bag left on a departed train; work-time phone availability is one terminal contact detail, not the five-task causal plot.

Current personal visitor opinion was mistaken for a test with a correct number, including semantic explanation and unseen section handling. Prior household survey has two pending respondents and needs one agreed household response. Different ownership, misunderstanding and resolution.

Current school specifies name alignment on an English balance certificate before issue, with school copy/passport, name order, lead time and pickup deadline. Prior employer input field cannot contain a long already registered account name; it concerns input abbreviation/method, not certificate issue.

Current cancellation attempt disconnected before booking identity/datetime confirmation, so cancellation completion is unknown and requested. Prior unreachable old telephone registration does not cancel the existing booking and requires new contact registration. Distinct failed operation versus contact-record correction.
